newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks up at open.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks up at open.

text.p: U.S. stocks were higher at the open on Wednesday as comments by Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan before the opening bell soothed stock and bond investors at least for the time being.
The Dow Jones Industrial average was up 10 points at 6,863, the Nasdaq Composite gained five to 1,322 and the S&P Index was up fractionally at 792.
The 30-year long bond was up 4/32 to yield 6.86 percent.
